Introduction
This document details the testing steps P1, which are
 performed on the fault recorder type 2000 manufacturer Enertic, on a semi
 annual basis M5 (every 6 months).
Safety Precautions
Work order should be issud,
The fault recorder should be in service,
Appropriate personnel protective equipment must be used.
Work order should be issud,
The fault recorder should be in service,
Appropriate personnel protective equipment must be used.
Tools and Equipment
Normal multimeter or digital Multimeter,
Complete set of screwdrive.
Blower.
Work to be Carried Out
Testing Procedures
Preparation
1. | Clean the outside casing of the fault recorder from
 the dust using the blower.
2. | Ensure that the operation lamps are in the correct
 position reference to MPIS doc's no. PC-SS-000- -r0.
3. | Check that all connections of the complete fault
 recorder system "not loose".
4. | Measure the output of the DC/DC converter to UR2000,
 and acquisition units.
Testing the Printer
1. | Check the operation of the printer by pressing on the
 switch no. (5) and switch the power supply of the printer to ON
 position. To stop the printer, switch the power supply of the printer to
 OFF position
2. | Check the selection switch of the required printer
 (SW1, SW2, SW21, SW22, SW23, SW24).
Function Test
1. | Check and review the programming of all functions of
 the fault recorder.
2. | Check the scales waves form of the sheet o/p and its
 values.
3. | Function of fault recorder units through the five
 lines indicating definite values and waveform (computer-Printer-Monitor-
 Keyboard-Auxiliaries).
4. | Function test must be carried out for master (UR2000)
 and other units using the keyboard.
